name: wrapped-navbar-divider
goal: Separate the wrapped branch and commit row from navigation with a visible divider.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Shared navbar needs a full-width divider only when revision controls wrap below categories.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing responsive shell checkpoint covered wrapping and compactness but not row separation; added divider assertions at the same three viewport checkpoints.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: At fe3db6ef, desktop passed and wrapped tablet/phone checkpoints failed on the missing divider; record 9784d01e. Before screenshots retained from the same test.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Added a theme-colored, full-width separator on the shared compact revision row below 1420px; field size and wide layout unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged responsive regression passed all three viewports at 285632b1; green 19e87cd4 paired with red 9784d01e. Desktop stays inline; tablet/phone show the divider.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports full check passed (582 units, types, lint, build, audit); 76 shell browser cases passed. Fresh before/after images and 920px live screenshot inspected; no console errors. Native/root aggregate stayed paused.
